items.title: Zugwise: Domain-Aware Game Reconstruction for Digitizing Handwritten Chess Scoresheets
items.titleZh: Zugwise：用于数字化手写国际象棋记分表的领域感知游戏重建
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14544v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Digitizing handwritten chess scoresheets has been studied as a handwriting-recognition problem: read the move in each box and check that it is legal. This framing misses the errors that matter most. A misread that yields an illegal move is loud. One that yields a legal-but-wrong move is silent, because a legality-only pipeline accepts it and reads every later move against a wrong position. We therefore treat the task as game reconstruction and present Zugwise, which repurposes computer-chess machinery (quiescence search, static exchange evaluation, pin detection) to ask not "what should be played?" but "could a human plausibly have written this?" An absurdity detector makes silent errors loud at or near where they occur, and a backward search traces late symptoms to their cause. Candidate ranking excludes chess-quality signals. A Needleman-Wunsch merge adds the second player's sheet as evidence, and review stops send every disagreement between the sheets' legal readings to a human. In oracle replay of two tournament sections, a release adding them cuts silent errors from 16 to 1 and from 50 to 13. Two learned signals, CTC re-scoring against the recognizer's raw output and a Maia-style human-move prior, raise the correct fix's top-rank rate from 58.8% to 78.0% of the replacement decisions where it is a candidate, and hold without refitting on a later section. On the first section, the human-verified output matches an independent expert transcription move for move on 34 of 45 games, and adjudication against the sheets found errors in both records, on different plies. We do not establish that either workflow is faster or more accurate. The system runs entirely in the browser and is free, private, and offline-capable; alongside it we offer a three-way adjudication protocol for a domain where no single record is ground truth.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14544v1 公告类型：新
摘要：手写国际象棋记分表的数字化已作为手写识别问题进行了研究：读取每个框中的棋步并检查其是否合法。这个框架忽略了最重要的错误。导致非法举动的误读是响亮的。产生合法但错误的举动的行为是沉默的，因为仅合法性的管道接受它并读取针对错误位置的每一个后续举动。因此，我们将这项任务视为游戏重建，并提出了 Zugwise，它重新利用了计算机国际象棋机制（静态搜索、静态交换评估、针检测）来询问“应该玩什么？”但“这可能是人类写的吗？”荒谬检测器会在无声错误发生的地方或附近发出响亮的声音，并且向后搜索会追踪晚期症状及其原因。候选排名不包括国际象棋质量信号。 Needleman-Wunsch 合并添加了第二个玩家的表格作为证据，并且审查停止将表格的合法读数之间的所有分歧发送给人类。在两个锦标赛部分的预言机重播中，添加它们的版本将静默错误从 16 个减少到 1 个，从 50 个减少到 13 个。两个学习信号（CTC 针对识别器的原始输出重新评分和 Maia 式的人类移动先验）将正确修复的最高排名率从候选替换决策的 58.8% 提高到 78.0%，并且在后面的部分中保持不变，无需重新调整。在第一部分中，经过人工验证的输出与独立专家转录的 45 场比赛中的 34 场比赛的走法相匹配，并且对表格的裁决发现了不同层数的两条记录中的错误。我们并没有确定工作流程更快或更准确。该系统完全在浏览器中运行，免费、私密且可离线使用；除此之外，我们还为没有单一记录是真实事实的领域提供三向裁决协议。

items.title: Cleaning an Agent's History Hurts When the World Still Holds the Error
items.titleZh: 当世界仍然存在错误时，清理特工的历史会很痛苦
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14654v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Tool-using language-model agents accumulate histories of their own mistakes, and a system that compacts, repairs or hands off such a history decides what it says about those mistakes while their effects stay in the world. Prior work cleans the history at a fixed world, where showing a corrected step and saying it is done move together. We ask whether the same correct content helps or hurts depending on how the history states it and what the world holds. We freeze an agent mid-task with its exact world state, edit the history or the world, and let a receiver model continue. On AgentCE-Bench, after the agent commits a wrong value, we hold the world fixed and add the correct value by two natural edits: a truthful note beside the preserved error or the agent's own completed action. The note raises recovery, the share of remaining targets the receiver gets right, from 51% under a matched neutral note to 66%. The completed action lowers it below the unedited history, from 50% to 44%, so the value's presence alone does not predict the effect. On AppWorld, after a database write, we vary whether its receipt reports success or failure and whether its effect is present. A success receipt lowers whole-task success from 45% to 28% while the effect is absent and raises it from 38% to 49% once present. The two effects differ by 27 points pooled over two receivers, a difference positive in six of eight receivers at 97.5% and seven at 95%. A history edit's effect thus depends on the world it describes, and a history made to look clean while the world still holds the error can leave an agent worse off than no edit at all.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14654v1 公告类型：新
摘要：使用工具的语言模型智能体会积累自己错误的历史，而压缩、修复或移交此类历史的系统会决定如何描述这些错误，同时它们的影响仍然存在。之前的工作清理了固定世界中的历史，其中显示正确的步骤并说它已经完成，一起移动。我们要问的是，同样正确的内容是有益还是有害，这取决于历史如何表述以及世界所持有的观点。我们用其确切的世界状态冻结代理中间任务，编辑历史或世界，然后让接收器模型继续。在 AgentCE-Bench 上，在代理提交错误值后，我们保持世界固定，并通过两次自然编辑添加正确的值：保留的错误旁边的真实注释或代理自己完成的操作。该注释提高了恢复率，即接收者正确执行的剩余目标的比例，从匹配的中性注释下的 51% 提高到 66%。已完成的操作会将其降低到未编辑历史记录以下，从 50% 降至 44%，因此仅该值的存在并不能预测效果。在 AppWorld 上，数据库写入后，我们会改变其收据报告成功还是失败以及其效果是否存在。当效果不存在时，成功收据会将整个任务的成功率从 45% 降低到 28%，而一旦出现，则将整体任务成功率从 38% 提高到 49%。两名接球手的两种效应合计相差 27 分，八名接球手中的六名（97.5%）为正差异，七名（95%）为正差异。因此，历史编辑的效果取决于它所描述的世界，而在世界仍然存在错误的情况下，历史记录看起来很干净，这可能会让代理的处境比根本没有编辑更糟糕。

items.title: Together Compiler: Continual Compilation for AI Inference
items.titleZh: Together Compiler：用于 AI 推理的持续编译
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14681v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Today's AI workloads are rapidly changing: new models are released more often, model architectures are increasingly diverse, and traffic distributions change frequently. The challenge we face at Together AI is continual optimization for these changing workloads. Compiling a deployment into an optimized forward pass is a challenge that is well-suited for agent hill-climbing. Existing systems struggle with continual compilation due to a tradeoff between measurement throughput and fidelity. Many systems use agents to optimize individual kernels from the inference forward pass using offline benchmarks, but timings are low-fidelity because of data-dependent behavior in primitives like mixture-of-experts (MoE). On the other hand, systems use agents to directly optimize end-to-end engines but suffer from slow engine launch times. To address these challenges, we build Together Compiler (TKCC), the first truly continual agent loop designed for AI inference optimization. To address the throughput-fidelity tradeoff, we propose: (1) a Tiered Persistent Engine that decouples engine launch overheads from forward pass computation; (2) a cost model to select the parallelism configurations that seed the optimization process. We also conduct extensive ablations on agent context management and present our insights on deploying TKCC in production. TKCC outperforms highly-optimized hand-written Megakernels on the Llama 1B workhorse workload by up to 1.7x and the best open source engines on the latest frontier models (Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash) across hardware platforms by up to 2.6x higher TPS on the InferenceX benchmark. TKCC also sets the state-of-the-art performance at batch size 1, with 1111 TPS on M3.1 Flash and 1205 TPS on DeepSeek v4.1 Flash. Finally, TKCC generalizes beyond frontier language model inference. TKCC serves trillions of tokens across our production fleet.

摘要：当今的人工智能工作负载正在快速变化：新模型发布更加频繁，模型架构日益多样化，流量分布频繁变化。 Together AI 面临的挑战是针对这些不断变化的工作负载进行持续优化。将部署编译为优化的前向传递是一项非常适合代理爬山的挑战。由于测量吞吐量和保真度之间的权衡，现有系统难以持续编译。许多系统使用代理通过使用离线基准的推理前向传递来优化各个内核，但由于专家混合 (MoE) 等原语中的数据依赖行为，计时保真度较低。另一方面，系统使用代理直接优化端到端引擎，但会遇到引擎启动时间缓慢的问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们构建了 Together Compiler (TKCC)，这是第一个真正为 AI 推理优化而设计的连续代理循环。为了解决吞吐量与保真度的权衡，我们建议：（1）分层持久引擎，将引擎启动开销与前向传递计算分离； (2) 用于选择为优化过程提供种子的并行配置的成本模型。我们还对代理上下文管理进行了广泛的消融，并提出了我们对在生产中部署 TKCC 的见解。在 Llama 1B 主力工作负载上，TKCC 的性能比高度优化的手写 Megakernel 高出 1.7 倍，在跨硬件平台上的最新前沿模型（Kimi K3、GLM 5.3、MiniMax M3.1 Flash、DeepSeek v4.1 Flash）上，TKCC 的性能比最佳开源引擎高出高达 2.6 倍。 TKCC 还在批量大小 1 时设置了最先进的性能，在 M3.1 闪存上达到 1111 TPS，在 DeepSeek v4.1 闪存上达到 1205 TPS。最后，TKCC 推广了超越前沿的语言模型推理。 TKCC 为我们的生产群中的数万亿代币提供服务。

items.title: When Should Semantic Priors Enter Partially-Identified Causal Discovery?
items.titleZh: 语义先验何时应进入部分识别的因果发现？
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14736v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Observational causal discovery often leaves causal di- rections unresolved or unstable. Large language mod- els (LLMs) can provide semantic information to resolve these directions, but incorrect proposals can exclude the true causal graph and invalidate downstream inference. We study three separate decisions: where to allocate semantic queries, which proposals to admit, and which causal graphs to retain. Our framework distinguishes population non-identifiability from finite-sample insta- bility, evaluates semantic orientation against statistical and random controls, and examines calibrated admis- sion and error-tolerant DAG retention. Experiments across benchmark networks show that semantic infor- mation improves recovery over coin-flip orientations, but targeting unstable edges has no established ad- vantage over matched-random allocation. The tested admission certificate cannot support nontrivial admis- sion with the available calibration tasks. Moreover, downstream retention depends on reference adequacy: learned references contain the true DAG in only three of 80 planned tasks. These findings separate the value of semantic information from the reliability of its alloca- tion, admission, and retention, and identify calibration size and reference adequacy as key limitations.

arXiv:2611.14736v1 公告类型：新
摘要：观察性因果发现常常导致因果方向未解决或不稳定。大型语言模型（LLM）可以提供语义信息来解决这些方向，但不正确的建议可能会排除真正的因果图并使下游推理无效。我们研究三个独立的决策：在哪里分配语义查询、接受哪些建议以及保留哪些因果图。我们的框架区分总体不可识别性和有限样本不稳定性，根据统计和随机控制评估语义方向，并检查校准准入和容错 DAG 保留。跨基准网络的实验表明，语义信息可以改善硬币翻转方向的恢复，但针对不稳定的边缘与匹配随机分配相比没有确定的优势。测试的准入证书无法支持具有可用校准任务的重要准入。此外，下游保留取决于参考的充分性：学习的参考仅在 80 个计划任务中的三个中包含真正的 DAG。这些发现将语义信息的价值与其分配、接纳和保留的可靠性分开，并将校准大小和参考充分性确定为关键限制。

items.title: SynthCorp: A Platform for Creating Benchmarks for Data Agents
items.titleZh: SynthCorp：为数据代理创建基准的平台
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14765v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Current benchmarks for LLM-driven data agents saturate quickly and cannot target specific capabilities. We present SynthCorp, a platform that creates customizable data estates and benchmarks by simulating how business events produce and modify corporate data over time. Each data estate combines relational databases, a document store, and a data catalog, paired with evaluation tasks and executable gold programs. First, given a scenario and target complexity dimensions, SynthCorp synthesizes reusable event types and compiles each into a program over predefined simulation primitives. Second, SynthCorp schedules event instances on a virtual calendar, interleaving routine and disruption events so that tables, documents, and catalog entries remain consistent. Third, SynthCorp executes the calendar to materialize the data estate and records every operation in a simulation log. Fourth, SynthCorp generates analytical tasks and derives verified gold programs from the log. We use SynthCorp to generate initial evaluation benchmarks comprising seven data estates (up to 1K operational tables) and 256 tasks across five domains. The data estates pass deterministic pipeline checks (such as foreign-key violations, undeclared writes, recurrence violations, and database execution failures) with a near-zero error rate, introduce cross-asset complexities, and cover all requested dimensions. Evaluating three models across four data-context settings shows that the benchmarks separate data contexts and model tiers. Auditing candidate queries against causal provenance in the simulation log verifies gold programs without manual annotation, including on multi-event composite tasks that expose reasoning failures in state-of-the-art agents. We hope the community uses SynthCorp to generate more challenging and useful data estates and benchmarks that foster the development of enterprise data agents.

arXiv:2611.14765v1 公告类型：新
摘要：当前由 LLM 驱动的数据代理的基准很快就会饱和，并且无法针对特定功能。我们推出 SynthCorp，这是一个通过模拟业务事件如何随着时间的推移产生和修改公司数据来创建可定制的数据资产和基准的平台。每个数据资产都结合了关系数据库、文档存储和数据目录，并配有评估任务和可执行的黄金程序。首先，给定场景和目标复杂性维度，SynthCorp 综合可重用的事件类型，并通过预定义的模拟原语将每个事件类型编译成程序。其次，SynthCorp 在虚拟日历上安排事件实例，交错例行事件和中断事件，以便表格、文档和目录条目保持一致。第三，SynthCorp 执行日历来具体化数据资产，并将每个操作记录在模拟日志中。第四，SynthCorp 生成分析任务并从日志中导出经过验证的黄金程序。我们使用 SynthCorp 生成初始评估基准，其中包括七个数据资产（最多 1K 个操作表）和跨五个领域的 256 个任务。数据资产以接近零的错误率通过确定性管道检查（例如外键违规、未声明的写入、重复违规和数据库执行失败），引入跨资产复杂性，并涵盖所有请求的维度。通过四种数据上下文设置评估三个模型表明，基准测试将数据上下文和模型层分开。根据模拟日志中的因果来源审核候选查询，无需手动注释即可验证黄金程序，包括暴露最先进代理中推理失败的多事件复合任务。我们希望社区使用 SynthCorp 生成更具挑战性和有用的数据资产和基准，以促进企业数据代理的发展。

items.title: Rational Use of Time for Social Coordination in Humans and AI
items.titleZh: 人类和人工智能社会协调的时间合理利用
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14766v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: All social interactions are situated in time. Previous studies have shown that humans are able to use implicit temporal cues, such as the duration of a pause, to infer others' mental states. But how do humans use temporal cues for dynamic, fine-grained social coordination? And can AI systems do the same, without ``experiencing'' continuous real-time as humans do? We study these questions using a cooperative card game task called The Mind, which requires players to achieve a shared goal across repeated interactions but forbids explicit communication: the only available signal is the passage of time. We evaluate 150 humans, and two classes of AI models which reflect different ways of operationalizing time in artificial systems: computer-use agents (CUAs), and standard text-prompted LLMs. We find that human behavior is best captured by a Bayesian strategy that infers a partner's belief from their timing---and similarly for frontier models. However, unlike humans, none of the tested models seem to efficiently adapt their behaviors to their partners' over the course of the game. From a cognitive perspective, our findings suggest that humans perform implicit probabilistic reasoning about continuous-time signals in dynamic social settings, and that such reasoning mechanisms may emerge without real-time experience. Practically, our study highlights new challenges for AI systems to coordinate efficiently with other agents by learning to interpret and adapt to their implicit signals in dynamic settings.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14766v1 公告类型：新
摘要：所有的社会互动都发生在时间上。先前的研究表明，人类能够利用隐含的时间线索（例如暂停的持续时间）来推断他人的心理状态。但人类如何利用时间线索进行动态、细粒度的社会协调呢？人工智能系统可以做同样的事情，而不需要像人类那样“体验”连续的实时吗？我们使用名为“The Mind”的合作纸牌游戏任务来研究这些问题，该任务要求玩家通过重复的互动实现共同的目标，但禁止明确的沟通：唯一可用的信号是时间的流逝。我们评估了 150 名人类和两类人工智能模型，它们反映了人工系统中操作时间的不同方式：计算机使用代理 (CUA) 和标准文本提示的法学硕士。我们发现，贝叶斯策略可以最好地捕捉人类行为，该策略根据合作伙伴的时间推断出他们的信念——对于前沿模型来说也是如此。然而，与人类不同的是，所有经过测试的模型似乎都没有在游戏过程中有效地适应其伙伴的行为。从认知角度来看，我们的研究结果表明，人类在动态社会环境中对连续时间信号进行隐式概率推理，并且这种推理机制可能在没有实时经验的情况下出现。实际上，我们的研究强调了人工智能系统通过学习解释和适应动态环境中的隐式信号来与其他智能体进行有效协调的新挑战。

items.title: Leaderboard Hacking: Preference-Based Model Evaluations are Vulnerable to Manipulation
items.titleZh: 排行榜黑客：基于偏好的模型评估容易被操纵
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14769v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Arena-style rankings of language models are a widely used evaluation framework in online leaderboards, research papers, and model evaluation in production. These rankings aim to realistically assess model performance using pairwise comparisons of anonymous models on user prompts, aggregating votes via the Bradley-Terry model to produce the final ranking. However, we find that these leaderboards are highly vulnerable to several manipulation strategies that unscrupulous providers could use to boost a model's rank: strategic voting (individual votes that boost a model's rank, including votes on irrelevant models), strategic prompting (choosing prompts that favor a model), and strategic nomination (boosting the rank of a model by inserting irrelevant models). We demonstrate these effects on public leaderboard data, analyze the circumstances that cause these vulnerabilities, and describe approaches to safeguard against each attack. Notably, these issues hold for any preference-based evaluation using the Bradley-Terry model that allows open prompting, voting, or model submission. These manipulations boost the rank of nearly every tested model; each attack can boost a model by up to 15-20 places in a ranking and, combined, they can boost a model by up to 45 places.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14769v1 公告类型：新
摘要：Arena 式的语言模型排名是在线排行榜、研究论文和生产中的模型评估中广泛使用的评估框架。这些排名旨在通过根据用户提示对匿名模型进行成对比较来实际评估模型性能，并通过 Bradley-Terry 模型聚合投票以产生最终排名。然而，我们发现这些排行榜很容易受到不法提供商用来提高模型排名的几种操纵策略的影响：战略投票（提高模型排名的个人投票，包括对不相关模型的投票）、战略提示（选择有利于模型的提示）和战略提名（通过插入不相关模型来提高模型的排名）。我们展示了这些对公共排行榜数据的影响，分析了导致这些漏洞的情况，并描述了防范每种攻击的方法。值得注意的是，这些问题适用于使用允许公开提示、投票或模型提交的 Bradley-Terry 模型的任何基于偏好的评估。这些操作提高了几乎所有测试模型的排名；每次攻击可以将模型的排名提升最多 15-20 位，合计起来最多可以将模型提升 45 位。

items.title: Robust Task-Aware State Estimation from Pre-trained Perception
items.titleZh: 来自预训练感知的鲁棒任务感知状态估计
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14781v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Agents that perform state estimation using pretrained perception models, e.g., Vision-Language Models (VLMs), face the fundamental challenge that predictions are uncertain. Still, most approaches determinize these predictions into a single best-guess state and make decisions as if it were ground truth. This is brittle because when the guess is wrong, the agent's decisions may be unsafe or infeasible. At the other extreme, maintaining a full probability distribution over symbolic states is often intractable. We propose a middle path, drawing on the underlying probabilities the perception model already produces (e.g., a VLM's output-layer token distributions) to construct a $\theta$-confidence Minimal Belief Set (MBS$_\theta$), a minimal subset of states whose cumulative probability meets a user-specified belief-mass threshold. The minimality of an MBS$_\theta$ ensures that the agent considers only the most likely states, enhancing robustness in downstream decision-making while maintaining computational tractability. Using a novel three-layered belief system, we efficiently approximate individual state probabilities from per-feature predictions and task-level constraints. On this belief construction, we base our MBS$_\theta$ construction, while maintaining only a lean factored representation of the belief. Our algorithm, Probability-Ranked Valid State Search (PRaVaSS), takes advantage of the unique structure of this belief system to construct an MBS$_\theta$ with correctness guarantees and polynomial complexity in the unconstrained case. Using a VLM as the backbone of our state estimator, we validate our method's theoretical properties, scalability with problem size, and improvement of downstream decision-making when used in a task-planning pipeline.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14781v1 公告类型：新
摘要：使用预训练感知模型（例如视觉语言模型（VLM））执行状态估计的智能体面临着预测不确定的根本挑战。尽管如此，大多数方法仍将这些预测确定为单一的最佳猜测状态，并像基本事实一样做出决策。这是脆弱的，因为当猜测错误时，智能体的决定可能是不安全或不可行的。在另一个极端，维持符号状态的完整概率分布通常很棘手。我们提出了一条中间路径，利用感知模型已经产生的潜在概率（例如，VLM 的输出层令牌分布）来构建 $\theta$ 置信度最小信念集（MBS$_\theta$），这是其累积概率满足用户指定的信念质量阈值的状态的最小子集。 MBS$_\theta$ 的极小性确保代理仅考虑最可能的状态，从而增强下游决策的稳健性，同时保持计算的易处理性。使用新颖的三层信念系统，我们可以根据每个特征的预测和任务级约束有效地近似个体状态概率。在此信念构建的基础上，我们以 MBS$_\theta$ 构建为基础，同时仅维持信念的精益分解表示。我们的算法，概率排名有效状态搜索（PRaVaSS），利用这个信念系统的独特结构来构造一个MBS$_\theta$，在无约束的情况下具有正确性保证和多项式复杂性。使用 VLM 作为状态估计器的支柱，我们验证了我们的方法的理论特性、问题大小的可扩展性，以及在任务规划管道中使用时下游决策的改进。

items.title: When Is Proof-Step Verification Worth Its Cost? Operating Requirements of Certify-or-Decline Verification for Open-Weight Mathematical Reasoning
items.titleZh: 证明步骤验证什么时候值得付出代价？开放重量数学推理的“确认或拒绝”验证的操作要求
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14794v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Proof-step verification rewrites a solver's answer into typed steps and uses LLM judges to certify or decline. We evaluate this pipeline on open-weight models across GPQA, AIME-2025, and a MATH-500 subset. Certification raises answer-key-match precision by 31 percentage points on the strong GPQA configuration and 46 on AIME, while answering only 35% and 21% of attempts. On near-ceiling MATH-500, gains are at most 5 points at a loss of 13-27 points of coverage. An output-token-matched self-consistency selector obtains 82.9% precision at 35% coverage, compared with the verifier's pooled 87.6% (paired difference: +4.8 points, 95% interval [-8.2, 18.5]). A diagnostic sample reveals a distinct failure mode: 52 of 88 completed problems end in invalid proof construction without ever reaching a judge. Finally, external-LLM acceptance of rendered certified chains is 61.0-67.6%, compared with 87.6% answer-key match. These audits lack human or formal-kernel ground truth. Open-weight auditor pairs show near-zero chance-corrected agreement, which measures consistency rather than accuracy against proof truth. These results motivate separate reporting of execution failures, selected-answer precision, and independently assessed proof validity. We provide per-configuration results and evaluation details in the supplement.

arXiv:2611.14794v1 公告类型：新
摘要：证明步骤验证将求解器的答案重写为键入的步骤，并使用 LLM 法官来证明或拒绝。我们在 GPQA、AIME-2025 和 MATH-500 子集的开放权重模型上评估此流程。认证将强大的 GPQA 配置上的答案键匹配精度提高了 31 个百分点，将 AIME 上的答案键匹配精度提高了 46 个百分点，而仅回答了 35% 和 21% 的尝试。在接近上限的 MATH-500 上，在损失 13-27 个点的情况下，最多只能获得 5 个点的收益。输出令牌匹配的自一致性选择器在 35% 覆盖率下获得 82.9% 的精度，而验证者的汇总精度为 87.6%（配对差值：+4.8 点，95% 区间 [-8.2, 18.5]）。诊断样本揭示了一种独特的失败模式：88 个已完成的问题中有 52 个以无效的证明构造而告终，而没有到达法官的手中。最后，外部法学硕士对经过认证的连锁店的接受率为 61.0-67.6%，而答案匹配率为 87.6%。这些审计缺乏人类或正式内核的基本事实。开放权重审核员对显示出接近零机会校正的一致性，该一致性衡量的是一致性，而不是针对证明事实的准确性。这些结果促使单独报告执行失败、选择答案的精度以及独立评估的证明有效性。我们在补充中提供每个配置的结果和评估详细信息。

items.title: GenPFN: An In-Context Tabular Foundation Model Approach for Augmenting Small Datasets in Engineering
items.titleZh: GenPFN：一种用于增强工程中小型数据集的上下文表格基础模型方法
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14804v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Costly simulations and experiments limit the data available for engineering design. This paper proposes GenPFN, a training-free candidate generator guided by a pretrained tabular Prior-Data Fitted Network (TabPFN) classifier with fixed weights. The context contains evaluated designs labeled desired (Class 1) or undesired (Class 0). GenPFN interpolates between desired designs and refines candidates using gated classifier gradients and Gaussian noise. Each candidate is evaluated using the problem's constraints and objective functions. Evaluated desired designs and their objective values augment the context for regression training.
 Evaluation spans fourteen selected problems, including a two-parameter benchmark and a 44-parameter hull problem. In paired comparisons, GenPFN with TabPFN v1 achieves higher class satisfaction and lower realism distance than the tested adversarial, variational-autoencoder and diffusion generators. The variational-autoencoder generator provides greater coverage and diversity. Relative to the synthetic minority over-sampling technique (SMOTE), GenPFN provides lower coverage distance and greater diversity. Among observed paired regression fits, augmentation reduces estimated AutoGluon validation mean squared error by 62.1% relative to context-only training. A hull-stern case study yields 99.3% propeller-compatible candidates versus 1.4% among randomly sampled context designs. Generation followed by evaluation produces sample sets that augment limited datasets and support training more accurate predictive models.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14804v1 公告类型：新
摘要：昂贵的模拟和实验限制了可用于工程设计的数据。本文提出了 GenPFN，这是一种免训练候选生成器，由具有固定权重的预训练表格先验数据拟合网络（TabPFN）分类器引导。上下文包含标记为所需（1 类）或不需要（0 类）的已评估设计。 GenPFN 在所需设计之间进行插值，并使用门控分类器梯度和高斯噪声细化候选设计。使用问题的约束和目标函数来评估每个候选者。评估所需的设计及其目标值增强了回归训练的背景。
 评估涵盖 14 个选定的问题，包括一个两参数基准问题和一个 44 参数船体问题。在配对比较中，与测试的对抗性、变分自动编码器和扩散生成器相比，GenPFN 与 TabPFN v1 实现了更高的类别满意度和更低的现实距离。变分自动编码器生成器提供了更大的覆盖范围和多样性。相对于合成少数过采样技术（SMOTE），GenPFN 提供更短的覆盖距离和更大的多样性。在观察到的配对回归拟合中，相对于仅上下文训练，增强将估计的 AutoGluon 验证均方误差减少了 62.1%。船尾案例研究得出了 99.3% 的螺旋桨兼容候选方案，而随机抽样的背景设计中只有 1.4%。生成后进行评估会产生样本集，这些样本集可以扩充有限的数据集并支持训练更准确的预测模型。

items.title: AutoAssumption: Searching over Assumptions Discovers ML-Systems Algorithms
items.titleZh: AutoAsuction：搜索假设发现机器学习系统算法
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14844v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Many advances in ML systems came from breaking an assumption that earlier methods took for granted: speculative decoding dropped the assumption that a model needs one forward pass per token. Yet algorithms rarely state their assumptions, so experts and discovery harnesses search over programs, where one edit changes several design choices and gains are difficult to attribute. Searching over the assumptions themselves remains largely unexplored. Writing algorithms as proofs makes their assumptions explicit and turns algorithm design into a search over a small, structured space that an LLM can explore and a proof checker can audit. We formalize 89 algorithms from KV-cache eviction, weight pruning and speculative decoding as proof graphs with explicit assumptions, checked in Lean. Our harness, AutoAssumption, relaxes one assumption of a published method, re-derives and re-proves it, and generates its code. In KV-cache eviction and weight pruning, this search improved on every published algorithm we ran and produced state-of-the-art algorithms. The eviction algorithm has the highest RULER-4K score of the published methods we ran, and the pruning algorithm the lowest perplexity of thirteen on four LLaMA models. At equal budget, the harness scores within a point of OpenEvolve, an open-source implementation of AlphaEvolve, with a lower standard deviation across repeats. Future work will formalize more fields and combine them through the principal assumptions they share.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14844v1 公告类型：新
摘要：机器学习系统的许多进步都来自于打破了早期方法认为理所当然的假设：推测性解码放弃了模型需要每个令牌一次前向传递的假设。然而算法很少陈述他们的假设，因此专家和发现利用对程序的搜索，其中一次编辑改变了多个设计选择，并且收益很难归因。对假设本身的探索在很大程度上仍未得到探索。将算法编写为证明可以使假设变得明确，并将算法设计转变为对法学硕士可以探索、证明检查员可以审核的小型结构化空间的搜索。我们将来自 KV 缓存驱逐、权重修剪和推测解码的 89 种算法形式化为具有明确假设的证明图，并在 Lean 中进行了检查。我们的工具 AutoAssumation 放宽了对已发布方法的一个假设，重新推导并重新证明它，并生成其代码。在 KV 缓存驱逐和权重修剪方面，该搜索改进了我们运行的每个已发布算法，并生成了最先进的算法。在我们运行的已发布方法中，驱逐算法具有最高的 RULER-4K 分数，而修剪算法在四个 LLaMA 模型上的困惑度最低为 13。在相同的预算下，该线束的得分在 OpenEvolve（AlphaEvolve 的开源实现）的一个点内，且重复次数的标准偏差较低。未来的工作将正式化更多领域，并通过它们共享的主要假设将它们结合起来。

items.title: Open Challenges and Opportunities in Human-Agent Systems
items.titleZh: 人类代理系统中的开放挑战和机遇
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14846v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Agentic AI systems increasingly undertake extended tasks and act on people's behalf, making human-agent interaction central to their effectiveness. Successful interaction requires understanding human perspectives, coordinating complementary capabilities, and maintaining productive relationships within socio-technical environments. This paper examines how foundations developed by the Autonomous Agents and Multi-Agent Systems (AAMAS) community inform these demands. We consider interactions ranging from individual human-agent partnerships to teams and larger groups, where participants differ in their roles, decision authority, capabilities, and objectives. We organize computational approaches around the connected challenges of understanding others and deciding how to interact with them. Theory of Mind, belief-desire-intention architectures, goal and plan recognition, inverse planning, and recursive reasoning provide mechanisms for representing and inferring partially observable mental states. Observer-aware planning, model reconciliation, and decision-theoretic communication connect these inferences to action, explanation, and information exchange. Together with shared autonomy, argumentation, and cooperative inverse reinforcement learning, these approaches offer foundations for agentic systems that account for evolving human knowledge, intentions, and expectations. We argue that progress requires treating human interaction as an ongoing decision problem shaped by uncertainty, interdependence, and potentially conflicting objectives.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14846v1 公告类型：新
摘要：智能体人工智能系统越来越多地承担扩展任务并代表人们行事，使人与智能体的交互成为其有效性的核心。成功的互动需要理解人类的观点、协调互补能力以及在社会技术环境中维持富有成效的关系。本文探讨了自治代理和多代理系统 (AAMAS) 社区开发的基础如何满足这些需求。我们考虑的互动范围从个人与代理伙伴关系到团队和更大的团体，其中参与者的角色、决策权限、能力和目标各不相同。我们围绕理解他人并决定如何与他们互动的相互关联的挑战来组织计算方法。心灵理论、信念-欲望-意图架构、目标和计划识别、逆向规划和递归推理提供了表示和推断部分可观察心理状态的机制。观察者感知的规划、模型协调和决策理论沟通将这些推论与行动、解释和信息交换联系起来。与共享自主、论证和合作逆强化学习一起，这些方法为解释人类知识、意图和期望不断发展的代理系统提供了基础。我们认为，进步需要将人类互动视为一个持续的决策问题，该问题由不确定性、相互依赖和潜在冲突的目标构成。

items.title: Effective Teacher Support for Reasoning Distillation
items.titleZh: 教师对推理蒸馏的有效支持
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14850v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Forward-KL language-model distillation normally computes dense teacher and student scores over the full vocabulary at every supervised position, making training and stored teacher targets expensive. We instead distill from the teacher's highest-probability vocabulary fraction, renormalizing the retained mass as we sweep support from 100% to 0.01%. Our main study distills Qwen3 4B -> 1.7B. We confirm the broader support-reduction finding on larger Qwen3 8B -> 4B and Nemotron Nano 12B -> 9B pairs and under answer-only supervision. We evaluate generation primarily on MMLU-Pro and secondarily on GPQA-Diamond. Across the Qwen3 settings, retaining 0.01% of the vocabulary causes no observed MMLU-Pro degradation relative to full-vocabulary distillation, although disagreement with the complete teacher distribution increases. Nemotron Nano matches full-vocabulary MMLU-Pro at 0.1%, but smaller fractions fail to emit the closing reasoning tag, showing that the reliable cutoff depends on the model family. At 0.01% support, caching the retained next-token scores from the teacher forward pass cuts training step time by 38%, while restricting student output computation to those tokens cuts peak memory by 24%; neither causes observed MMLU-Pro degradation.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14850v1 公告类型：新
摘要：前向 KL 语言模型蒸馏通常会在每个监督位置的完整词汇上计算密集的教师和学生分数，这使得训练和存储的教师目标变得昂贵。相反，我们从教师的最高概率词汇分数中提取，当我们将支持度从 100% 扫到 0.01% 时，重新规范化保留的质量。我们的主要研究蒸馏了Qwen3 4B -> 1.7B。我们确认了在较大的 Qwen3 8B -> 4B 和 Nemotron Nano 12B -> 9B 对上以及在仅限答案的监督下更广泛的支持减少发现。我们主要在 MMLU-Pro 上评估生成，其次在 GPQA-Diamond 上评估。在 Qwen3 设置中，保留 0.01% 的词汇不会导致相对于全词汇蒸馏的 MMLU-Pro 退化，尽管与完整教师分布的分歧有所增加。 Nemotron Nano 与完整词汇表 MMLU-Pro 的匹配率为 0.1%，但较小的分数无法发出结束推理标签，这表明可靠的截止值取决于模型系列。在 0.01% 支持下，缓存来自教师前向传递的保留的下一个令牌分数可将训练步骤时间减少 38%，同时将学生输出计算限制为这些令牌可将峰值内存减少 24%；两者都不会导致观察到的 MMLU-Pro 降解。
items.author: Lavinia Ghita, Dhruv Desai

items.title: Can an AI Agent Be Epistemically Akratic? Higher-Order Evidence & the Limits of Self-Correction
items.titleZh: 人工智能代理可以在认知上变得不稳定吗？高阶证据与自我纠正的局限性
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14889v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: When we judge that our reasoning was defective, it seems plausible that we should abandon the conclusion it produced. This thought has special force for AI agents built to assess and correct their own work. Yet obeying such judgments can make an agent worse at distinguishing sound reasoning from defective reasoning. An AI agent may rely on information about its reasoning when deciding which conclusions to keep, while the part that judges whether those conclusions are justified cannot use that information. The agent can then exercise an epistemic competence by retaining conclusions it judges unjustified, even when its self-assessments are generally reliable. Nor is the difficulty resolved by training the agent to make its conclusions and assessments agree: agreement can be achieved by degrading either one. Crucially, I argue that a negative assessment can remain valuable by identifying conclusions requiring further scrutiny, without having authority to eliminate them. The result challenges a central assumption about AI self-correction: that bringing an agent's beliefs into agreement with its own self-assessment about their justification makes it better at correcting its mistakes.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14889v1 公告类型：新
摘要：当我们判断我们的推理有缺陷时，我们似乎应该放弃它所得出的结论。这种想法对于为评估和纠正自己的工作而构建的人工智能代理具有特殊的力量。然而，服从这样的判断可能会使智能体在区分合理推理和有缺陷推理方面变得更差。人工智能代理在决定保留哪些结论时可能依赖于其推理信息，而判断这些结论是否合理的部分则无法使用该信息。然后，代理人可以通过保留它认为不合理的结论来行使认知能力，即使它的自我评估通常是可靠的。训练智能体使其结论和评估一致也无法解决这一难题：通过降低其中任何一个的等级都可以达成一致。至关重要的是，我认为，通过确定需要进一步审查的结论，而不有权消除它们，负面评估仍然有价值。这一结果挑战了人工智能自我纠正的一个核心假设：让智能体的信念与其自身对其合理性的自我评估相一致，可以使其更好地纠正错误。

items.title: MuEdit: An efficient multi-task editing method towards inter-domain knowledge conflicts
items.titleZh: MuEdit：一种针对域间知识冲突的高效多任务编辑方法
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14910v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) require frequent knowledge updates across heterogeneous domains, but existing editing methods fail when applied sequentially to multi-task settings. We trace this collapse to inter-domain null-space misalignment: heterogeneous tasks induce distinct Jacobian geometries, causing their common null space to shrink dramatically and leaving insufficient admissible directions for conflict-free updates. We propose the Conflict Index to quantify this geometric interference, and introduce Mu-Edit, which mitigates multi-task conflicts via (1) conflict-aware ordering to minimize cumulative interference, and (2) dynamic low-rank approximation to expand the null space when ordering alone is insufficient. Experiments across five functional domains and three backbones show that Mu-Edit significantly outperforms existing baselines in multi-task editing performance while preserving general capabilities, and remains effective under incremental task arrival.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14910v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）需要跨异构领域频繁更新知识，但现有的编辑方法在顺序应用于多任务设置时会失败。我们将这种崩溃归因于域间零空间错位：异构任务会导致不同的雅可比几何形状，导致它们的公共零空间急剧缩小，并为无冲突更新留下足够的允许方向。我们提出冲突指数来量化这种几何干扰，并引入 Mu-Edit，它通过以下方式减轻多任务冲突：（1）冲突感知排序以最小化累积干扰，以及（2）动态低秩近似以在单独排序不足时扩展零空间。跨五个功能域和三个主干的实验表明，Mu-Edit 在多任务编辑性能方面显着优于现有基线，同时保留一般功能，并且在增量任务到达下仍然有效。
items.author: Songshi Liang, Ting-En Lin, Zixuan Huang, Yuchuan Wu, Yongbin Li, Zihe Wang, Rui Yan

items.title: CAFIN: CUDA-accelerated Adaptive Fisher Information Matrix Network Optimization via GPU-Native Kernel Fusion
items.titleZh: CAFIN：通过 GPU 原生内核融合实现 CUDA 加速的自适应 Fisher 信息矩阵网络优化
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14589v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Second-order optimizers improve deep neural network training using curvature information, but their practical efficiency is limited by GPU execution overhead. AdaFisher reduces Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) approximation costs through diagonal Kronecker structures and exponential moving averages, yet its PyTorch implementation requires sequential CUDA kernel launches, intermediate tensor allocations, and repeated memory accesses. We introduce CAFIN, a GPU-native CUDA kernel fusion framework that improves AdaFisher execution efficiency without changing its optimization formulation. The proposed approach progressively integrates FIM preconditioner construction, exponential moving average updates, gradient preconditioning, momentum accumulation, weight decay, and parameter updates into fused CUDA kernels. Shared-memory reuse, register-resident computation, and in-place operations further reduce memory traffic and intermediate allocations. Experiments using ResNet-18 on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet across NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti and RTX 3060 Laptop GPUs demonstrate up to 78.4% lower isolated FIM construction latency and 2.1-26.9% lower optimizer-step latency. The implementation also eliminates approximately 18.91 MB of intermediate GPU memory allocations per optimizer step. Numerical validation confirms consistency within the predefined FP32 tolerance, while convergence accuracy remains comparable across evaluated datasets and random seeds. These findings demonstrate that CUDA kernel fusion can substantially accelerate second-order optimization while preserving AdaFisher's underlying mathematical formulation and learning behavior.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14589v1 公告类型：新
摘要：二阶优化器利用曲率信息改进深度神经网络训练，但其实际效率受到 GPU 执行开销的限制。 AdaFisher 通过对角 Kronecker 结构和指数移动平均线降低了 Fisher 信息矩阵 (FIM) 近似成本，但其 PyTorch 实现需要顺序 CUDA 内核启动、中间张量分配和重复内存访问。我们介绍 CAFIN，一个 GPU 原生的 CUDA 内核融合框架，可以在不改变其优化公式的情况下提高 AdaFisher 的执行效率。所提出的方法逐步将 FIM 预处理器构造、指数移动平均更新、梯度预处理、动量累积、权重衰减和参数更新集成到融合的 CUDA 内核中。共享内存重用、寄存器驻留计算和就地操作进一步减少了内存流量和中间分配。在 NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti 和 RTX 3060 笔记本电脑 GPU 上的 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 Tiny ImageNet 上使用 ResNet-18 进行的实验表明，独立 FIM 构建延迟降低了 78.4%，优化器步骤延迟降低了 2.1-26.9%。该实现还消除了每个优化器步骤约 18.91 MB 的中间 GPU 内存分配。数值验证确认了预定义 FP32 容差内的一致性，而收敛精度在评估的数据集和随机种子之间保持可比性。这些发现表明，CUDA 内核融合可以显着加速二阶优化，同时保留 AdaFisher 的基础数学公式和学习行为。

items.title: An Asynchronous Federated Learning Platform for Lung Adenocarcinoma Grading via Foundation Models and Structural Pruning
items.titleZh: 通过基础模型和结构修剪进行肺腺癌分级的异步联合学习平台
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14590v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Classification of lung adenocarcinoma into poorly differentiated (PD) and well-to-moderately differentiated (WMD) subtypes plays an important role in patient survival; however, consistent classification is difficult due to inter-observer variability among pathologists. Collecting data from multiple hospitals is also challenging due to patient privacy concerns. This study proposes a web-based federated learning system that shares only locally trained model weights without sharing patient data between institutions. The UNI2 foundation model and CLAM-SB were used to classify pathological whole slide images. A four-client federated learning system was constructed, and the NLST cohort was reserved exclusively for external validation. In centralized evaluation, joint training with CPTAC and TCGA outperformed single-institution training on external validation, confirming the necessity of multi-institutional data integration. FedAvg, FedProx, FedBN, and FedNova were compared as federated learning algorithms under identical experimental conditions. Test AUC ranked as FedBN, FedProx, FedNova, and FedAvg. FedNova showed the most balanced classification performance between PD and WMD. L1-norm structural pruning at 20%, 30%, and 40% sparsity was applied to reduce model transmission size. FedAvg, FedProx, and FedBN showed a tendency of decreasing Test AUC under pruning, while FedNova achieved improved Test AUC across all sparsity levels. A web-based application was developed supporting slide upload, local training, AI classification, and attention heatmap-based visualization. The combination of FedNova and 40% pruning was confirmed as a practical approach that improves communication efficiency and classification performance while protecting patient privacy.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14590v1 公告类型：新
摘要：将肺腺癌分为低分化（PD）和中分化（WMD）亚型对患者生存起着重要作用。然而，由于病理学家之间观察者之间的差异，一致的分类是困难的。由于患者隐私问题，从多家医院收集数据也具有挑战性。这项研究提出了一种基于网络的联邦学习系统，该系统仅共享本地训练的模型权重，而不在机构之间共享患者数据。使用UNI2基础模型和CLAM-SB对病理全切片图像进行分类。构建了四客户端联邦学习系统，并且 NLST 队列专门保留用于外部验证。在集中评估中，与CPTAC和TCGA的联合培训在外部验证方面优于单机构培训，证实了多机构数据整合的必要性。 FedAvg、FedProx、FedBN 和 FedNova 作为联邦学习算法在相同的实验条件下进行了比较。测试 AUC 排名为 FedBN、FedProx、FedNova 和 FedAvg。 FedNova 显示了 PD 和 WMD 之间最平衡的分类性能。应用稀疏度为 20%、30% 和 40% 的 L1 范数结构修剪来减小模型传输大小。 FedAvg、FedProx 和 FedBN 在剪枝下表现出测试 AUC 降低的趋势，而 FedNova 在所有稀疏度水平上都实现了测试 AUC 的提高。开发了一个基于网络的应用程序，支持幻灯片上传、本地训练、人工智能分类和基于注意力热图的可视化。 FedNova 和 40% 剪枝的结合被证实是一种实用方法，可以提高通信效率和分类性能，同时保护患者隐私。
items.author: Moon-Il Joo, Md Ariful Islam Mozumder, Hee-Cheol Kim

items.title: Adversarial Risk in the Generative AI Era Necessitates Dropping the Small Epsilon Ball
items.titleZh: 生成式 AI 时代的对抗风险需要放弃小 Epsilon 球
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14594v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Adversarial Machine Learning research is currently centered on the search for the epsilon-ball: minimal perturbations designed to fool models while remaining imperceptible to humans. We argue that this fixation on $\ell_p$ norms is a metrological trap that communicates a distorted perception of risk to defenders, one that is unaligned with real-world system vulnerabilities. This paradigm misleads defenders into optimizing for narrow, mathematical robustness at the expense of systemic security, while simultaneously incentivizing attackers to exploit non-overlapping alternative adversarial pathways. Ultimately, we argue that the dominance of the $\ell_p$ ball does not just fail to reduce harm---it may actively facilitate it by communicating a false sense of security against the wrong threats.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14594v1 公告类型：新
摘要：对抗性机器学习研究目前集中在寻找 epsilon-ball：旨在愚弄模型同时保持人类难以察觉的最小扰动。我们认为，这种对 $\ell_p$ 规范的执着是一种计量陷阱，它向防御者传达了一种扭曲的风险认知，这种认知与现实世界的系统漏洞不一致。这种范式误导防御者以牺牲系统安全为代价来优化狭隘的数学鲁棒性，同时激励攻击者利用非重叠的替代对抗路径。最终，我们认为，$\ell_p$球的主导地位不仅不能减少伤害——它还可能通过传达针对错误威胁的错误安全感来积极促进伤害。

items.title: StructRL: Model-Free Reinforcement Learning with Replay Graphs
items.titleZh: StructRL：使用重放图的无模型强化学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14599v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: StructRL turns the experience collected during reinforcement learning into an explicit replay graph. Once the graph contains a path to the task goal, dynamic programming selects actions on the observed part of the state space; these actions form a graph policy that is defined only where the required transitions have been observed. StructRL transfers these actions to model-free learners: as action preferences for a DQN Q-model and as target directions along shortest observed paths for a SAC actor. For DQN on three sparse-reward MiniGrid tasks, final success rises from 0.10 to 0.90 (DoorKey), 0.10 to 0.80 (KeyCorridor) and 0 to 0.50 (ObstructedMaze); plain DQN does not catch up with three times the budget. For SAC on continuous PointMaze, graph-derived direction labels raise final success from 0.17 to 1.0 on seven matched runs that reached the goal. Distilling the graph policy into a fresh Q-model gives a DoorKey 6x6 controller that reaches the goal from 91% of reachable states, against 38% for plain DQN. Scaling experiments identify three bottlenecks: incomplete graph support, structural aliasing, and loss of graph information in high-dimensional inputs.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14599v1 公告类型：新
摘要：StructRL 将强化学习过程中收集的经验转化为显式的回放图。一旦图包含到达任务目标的路径，动态规划就会在状态空间的观察部分上选择操作；这些操作形成了一个图形策略，该策略仅在观察到所需转换的情况下定义。 StructRL 将这些动作传递给无模型学习者：作为 DQN Q 模型的动作偏好，以及作为 SAC 参与者沿最短观察路径的目标方向。对于三个稀疏奖励 MiniGrid 任务的 DQN，最终成功率从 0.10 升至 0.90 (DoorKey)、0.10 升至 0.80 (KeyCorridor) 和 0 升至 0.50 (ObstructedMaze)；普通 DQN 无法满足预算的三倍。对于连续 PointMaze 上的 SAC，在达到目标的七次匹配运行中，图形派​​生的方向标签将最终成功率从 0.17 提高到 1.0。将图策略提炼成新的 Q 模型后，DoorKey 6x6 控制器可以在 91% 的可到达状态下达到目标，而普通 DQN 只能达到 38%。扩展实验确定了三个瓶颈：不完整的图支持、结构混叠以及高维输入中图信息的丢失。

items.title: KernelMosaic: An Open Dataset and Agentic Framework for CUDA Kernel Generation
items.titleZh: KernelMosaic：用于 CUDA 内核生成的开放数据集和代理框架
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14604v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Training large language models to generate efficient CUDA kernels requires supervision spanning diverse computational requirements and iterative code optimization. Constructing this supervision is challenging because of heterogeneous specifications, and useful implementations emerge through iterative complicated testing and refinement. We introduce KernelMosaic, an open dataset pairing diverse CUDA tasks with verified solutions and trajectories. Human-guided review and diversity-aware selection curate tasks expressed as natural-language descriptions, reference programs, mathematical specifications, and their intersections. To build the solutions and trajectories, our agentic framework guides a strong LLM through implementation, correctness repair, and performance optimization with reusable CUDA guidance and execution feedback. Supervised fine-tuning of a small open-source model on KernelMosaic raises correctness from 4%, 0%, and 0% to 88%, 82%, and 16% on KernelBench L1, L2, and L3, respectively, while increasing the fraction of tasks with kernels faster than PyTorch eager at every level. Further training experiments show that supervision from the curated trajectories substantially outperforms direct responses and promotes sustained testing and revision. These results demonstrate that KernelMosaic enables a general-purpose model to achieve substantial gains in CUDA kernel generation.

arXiv:2611.14604v1 公告类型：新
摘要：训练大型语言模型以生成高效的 CUDA 内核需要跨越不同计算要求和迭代代码优化的监督。由于规范异构，构建这种监督具有挑战性，并且通过迭代复杂的测试和细化会出现有用的实现。我们引入 KernelMosaic，这是一个开放数据集，将不同的 CUDA 任务与经过验证的解决方案和轨迹配对。人工指导的审查和多样性意识的选择将任务表达为自然语言描述、参考程序、数学规范及其交叉点。为了构建解决方案和轨迹，我们的代理框架通过可重用的 CUDA 指导和执行反馈，通过实施、正确性修复和性能优化来指导强大的法学硕士。对 KernelMosaic 上的小型开源模型进行监督微调，在 KernelBench L1、L2 和 L3 上的正确率分别从 4%、0% 和 0% 提高到 88%、82% 和 16%，同时在每个级别都增加了比 PyTorch eager 更快的内核任务比例。进一步的训练实验表明，来自策划轨迹的监督大大优于直接响应，并促进持续的测试和修订。这些结果表明 KernelMosaic 使通用模型能够在 CUDA 内核生成方面取得实质性进展。

items.title: Thompson Sampling using Prior-fitted Diffusion Transformers
items.titleZh: 使用事先安装的扩散变压器进行 Thompson 采样
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14656v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Thompson sampling is natural randomized strategy for optimizing unknown functions in a black-box manner. In continuous global optimization, Thompson sampling has largely been restricted to Gaussian process priors, as these are essentially the only class for which computing the posterior distribution has been tractable in practice. In this work, we introduce \emph{prior-fitted diffusion transformers}, which are diffusion models that perform Thompson sampling in-context at inference time, after being pre-trained using the prior-fitted network paradigm. To apply these models, we develop a set of practical non-Gaussian priors for general black-box functions---including those that have characteristics that cannot be achieved under Gaussianity, such as priors over unimodal functions. We also quantify the tradeoff between model size and the number of pre-training iterations, and show that these models follow scaling laws akin to those observed in transformers defined over other modalities. Across a set of global optimization benchmarks, we show that prior-fitted diffusion transformers with non-Gaussian priors can achieve improved performance compared to traditional pipelines built on Gaussian processes.

arXiv:2611.14656v1 公告类型：新
摘要：汤普森采样是一种以黑盒方式优化未知函数的自然随机策略。在连续全局优化中，汤普森采样在很大程度上仅限于高斯过程先验，因为这些本质上是计算后验分布在实践中易于处理的唯一类别。在这项工作中，我们引入了 \emph{先验拟合扩散变压器}，它们是在使用先验拟合网络范式进行预训练后在推理时在上下文中执行汤普森采样的扩散模型。为了应用这些模型，我们为一般黑盒函数开发了一组实用的非高斯先验——包括那些具有在高斯性下无法实现的特征的函数，例如单峰函数的先验。我们还量化了模型大小和预训练迭代次数之间的权衡，并表明这些模型遵循类似于在其他模态定义的 Transformer 中观察到的缩放定律。在一组全局优化基准中，我们表明，与基于高斯过程构建的传统管道相比，具有非高斯先验的先验拟合扩散变压器可以实现更高的性能。

items.title: Closing the Loop: Co-Evolving EM for Irregular Time Series Generation in Lifted Representations
items.titleZh: 闭环：用于提升表示中的不规则时间序列生成的协同进化 EM
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14659v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Regular time-series generation from irregular time series is typically reduced to one-shot imputation: complete each partial sequence once, freeze the completions, and train a generator on the resulting surrogate dataset. We show that this open-loop strategy is structurally flawed. Point imputers collapse ambiguous missing regions to conditional averages, while stochastic imputers become stale as the generator evolves; the binding constraint is therefore iteration, not imputer design. We introduce a co-evolving Monte Carlo EM framework that closes the imputer-generator loop. Each E-step samples missing values from the posterior of the current generator, and each M-step retrains the generator on these completions, preserving unconditional generator training. Since our diffusion prior operates in a lifted 2D representation while observations live in time-series space, we further introduce Posterior Sampling for Lifted Representations (PSLR), which enforces operator-consistent conditioning, uncertainty preservation, and manifold consistency during the E-step. Across ten datasets and four corruption regimes, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving over the strongest baselines by 59% in discriminative score, 15% in predictive score, 73% in Context-FID, and 71% in feature-correlation error. Ablations show that our approach reduces average discriminative score by 73% over single-step baselines, closing most of the remaining gap to the clean-data oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/azencot-group/PSLR.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14659v1 公告类型：新
摘要：从不规则时间序列生成规则时间序列通常会简化为一次性插补：完成每个部分序列一次，冻结完成，并在生成的代理数据集上训练生成器。我们证明这种开环策略在结构上是有缺陷的。点插补器将不明确的缺失区域折叠为条件平均值，而随机插补器随着生成器的发展而变得陈旧；因此，绑定约束是迭代，而不是输入器设计。我们引入了一个共同进化的蒙特卡罗 EM 框架，该框架闭合了输入生成器循环。每个 E 步骤从当前生成器的后验中采样缺失值，每个 M 步骤在这些完成上重新训练生成器，保留无条件生成器训练。由于我们的扩散先验在提升的二维表示中运行，而观察则存在于时间序列空间中，因此我们进一步引入了提升表示的后验采样（PSLR），它在 E 步骤期间强制执行操作符一致的条件、不确定性保留和流形一致性。在 10 个数据集和 4 个腐败制度中，我们的方法实现了最先进的性能，判别得分比最强基线提高了 59%，预测得分提高了 15%，Context-FID 提高了 73%，特征相关误差提高了 71%。消融表明，与单步基线相比，我们的方法将平均判别得分降低了 73%，从而缩小了与干净数据预言机之间的大部分差距。代码可在 https://github.com/azencot-group/PSLR 获取。
items.author: Idan Arbiv, Gal Fadlon, Omri Azencot

items.title: Trait Hitchhiking in LLM Post-Training
items.titleZh: LLM 培训后的特质搭便车
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14683v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is now a standard stage of language model post-training, and the compute devoted to it is growing rapidly. While it has been shown to improve capabilities, particularly for tasks with verifiable rewards, it can also change behaviours and internal properties that the reward does not explicitly target. We present a formalism to describe the evolution of "traits" during RL post-training and, in doing so, recover the Price equation from evolutionary biology. We use this to develop a mathematical model for what we call "trait hitchhiking": the amplification or suppression of non-targeted traits as training redistributes probability across completions. We evaluate this Price update expression on language models trained with GRPO and show that the Price estimates closely track the sampled trait dynamics. These results identify trait hitchhiking as a mechanism by which RL post-training can silently amplify undesirable traits.

arXiv:2611.14683v1 公告类型：新
摘要：强化学习（RL）现已成为语言模型后训练的标准阶段，并且专用于其的计算量正在快速增长。虽然它已被证明可以提高能力，特别是对于具有可验证奖励的任务，但它也可以改变奖励未明确针对的行为和内部属性。我们提出了一种形式主义来描述 RL 训练后“特征”的演变，并在此过程中从进化生物学中恢复 Price 方程。我们用它来开发一个数学模型，用于所谓的“特质搭便车”：当训练重新分配完成概率时，非目标特质的放大或抑制。我们在使用 GRPO 训练的语言模型上评估此 Price 更新表达式，并表明 Price 估计密切跟踪采样的特征动态。这些结果表明，特质搭便车是强化学习训练后可以悄悄放大不良特质的一种机制。

items.title: Beyond Row-Level Prediction: Evaluating and Learning Composition for Reusable Table Representations
items.titleZh: 超越行级预测：评估和学习可重用表表示的组合
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14697v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Tables are compositional, with content spread across a schema, cell values, rows, and columns. Large-scale operations such as retrieval, overlap estimation, deduplication, and data curation need these local signals composed into one reusable embedding vector per table. Table representation methods, however, are mostly evaluated through row-level prediction or supervised downstream tasks, which do not measure table-level embedding quality directly. We introduce a benchmark that evaluates table-level embeddings through four desiderata: consistency under partial views, discriminability across label granularities, robustness to benign perturbations, and efficiency. Across twelve methods on synthetic and real corpora, lightweight schema- and text-based fingerprints are among the strongest. The sharpest contrast comes from two tabular foundation models, TabPFN and ConTextTab: although both are strong row-level predictors, their states, composed by mean, max, or three further parameter-free pooling rules, trail the strongest fingerprints. We therefore ask whether the gap lies in the encoder or in the compositional rule. Keeping ConTextTab frozen, we learn only the compositional rule over its cell states, using support-conditioned distribution matching (SCDM), a self-supervised loss we propose that matches the distribution of embedding similarities to the distribution of partition overlaps within and across tables. Across all fifteen head configurations, the learned rule raises the Spearman correlation between embedding similarity and partial-view overlap from 0.04 to 0.43-0.50 on synthetic data and improves triplet ranking, clustering, and retrieval, with smaller but systematic gains on real data. A downstream parent-table retrieval task confirms these findings. How local states are composed, and with what objective, substantially affects the quality of table-level embeddings.

arXiv:2611.14697v1 公告类型：新
摘要：表格是组合的，内容分布在模式、单元格值、行和列中。检索、重叠估计、重复数据删除和数据管理等大规模操作需要将这些本地信号组合成每个表一个可重用的嵌入向量。然而，表表示方法主要通过行级预测或监督下游任务来评估，这些任务不直接测量表级嵌入质量。我们引入了一个基准，通过四个需求来评估表级嵌入：部分视图下的一致性、跨标签粒度的可区分性、对良性扰动的鲁棒性和效率。在合成和真实语料库的十二种方法中，基于模式和文本的轻量级指纹是最强的。最鲜明的对比来自两个表格基础模型，TabPFN 和 ConTextTab：尽管两者都是强大的行级预测器，但它们的状态（由平均值、最大值或三个进一步的无参数池化规则组成）跟踪最强的指纹。因此，我们要问差距是否在于编码器或组合规则中。保持 ConTextTab 冻结，我们仅使用支持条件分布匹配（SCDM）来学习其单元格状态的组成规则，这是我们提出的一种自监督损失，它将嵌入相似性的分布与表内和表间的分区重叠分布相匹配。在所有 15 个头部配置中，学习到的规则将合成数据上嵌入相似性和部分视图重叠之间的 Spearman 相关性从 0.04 提高到 0.43-0.50，并改进了三元组排序、聚类和检索，对真实数据产生较小但系统的增益。下游父表检索任务证实了这些发现。本地状态的组成方式以及目标是什么，会极大地影响表级嵌入的质量。

items.title: Code as Explanations: Executable and Verifiable LLM Explanations
items.titleZh: 代码即解释：可执行且可验证的 LLM 解释
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14704v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly make consequential decisions and solve problems alongside humans, we must understand how models arrive at their conclusions. Understanding how an LLM behaves requires observing it across multiple inputs, yet free-text explanations such as chain-of-thought (CoT) are generated per instance and cannot be easily verified on new inputs. We propose {code explanations to address the mismatch in how LLM explanations are generated versus how they are evaluated: a program explains LLM behavior across a dataset of inputs, and its execution enables automatic verification. We define Consistency metric that measures the fraction of inputs on which the program reproduces the LLM's outputs, and use it to evaluate and select candidate programs. Across three open-source code-capable LLMs and eight tasks, we find that LLMs can produce highly consistent code explanations in several settings. Code explanations are also 6$\times$ to 100$\times$ shorter than CoT, and better align with model behavior in 9 out of 24 settings. However, consistency is significantly lower on tasks with more complex linguistic components, where generated programs reproduce model outputs no more frequently than an uninformative explanation baseline, and these programs often rely on longer hard-coded patterns. In experiments with Claude Opus 5.5, providing the model with consistency feedback and code execution improves explanation consistency across tasks, but consistency remains significantly lower on more complex tasks. Our findings establish executable code as a novel, verifiable, and compact approach to explaining LLM behavior and highlight verification feedback as a promising direction for improving explanation consistency. The code for this paper is at https://github.com/rajesh-lab/code-as-explanations.

摘要：随着大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地与人类一起做出相应的决策并解决问题，我们必须了解模型如何得出结论。了解 LLM 的行为方式需要跨多个输入进行观察，但自由文本解释（例如思想链 (CoT)）是根据实例生成的，无法在新输入上轻松验证。我们提出{代码解释来解决 LLM 解释的生成方式与评估方式之间的不匹配问题：程序解释跨输入数据集的 LLM 行为，其执行可以实现自动验证。我们定义一致性度量来衡量程序重现 LLM 输出的输入比例，并用它来评估和选择候选程序。在三个支持开源代码的法学硕士和八项任务中，我们发现法学硕士可以在多种设置中生成高度一致的代码解释。代码解释也比 CoT 短 6$\times$ 到 100$\times$，并且在 24 个设置中的 9 个设置中更好地与模型行为保持一致。然而，在具有更复杂语言组件的任务上，一致性显着降低，其中生成的程序再现模型输出的频率并不比无信息的解释基线更频繁，并且这些程序通常依赖于较长的硬编码模式。在 Claude Opus 5.5 的实验中，为模型提供一致性反馈和代码执行可以提高跨任务的解释一致性，但在更复杂的任务上，一致性仍然显着较低。我们的研究结果将可执行代码确立为一种新颖、可验证且紧凑的方法来解释 LLM 行为，并强调验证反馈是提高解释一致性的有希望的方向。本文的代码位于 https://github.com/rajesh-lab/code-as-explanations。

items.title: UniPipe: Unified Inference Serving and Fine-Tuning for Deadline-Constrained DNN Surrogate Workflows
items.titleZh: UniPipe：针对截止日期受限的 DNN 代理工作流程的统一推理服务和微调
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14748v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: DNN surrogates are increasingly used to accelerate scientific workflows that must process high-rate sensor streams in near real time, exemplified by Ptychographic imaging at next-generation X-ray light sources. Such surrogates deliver 100-1000x higher throughput than iterative solvers, enabling faster steering of experiments. To preserve surrogate accuracy during an experiment, as the input distribution evolves, state-of-the-art deployments freeze the pretrained surrogate or run a separate CUDA context that fine-tunes concurrently with serving. However, multi-context concurrency causes significant contention on the GPU, inflating both the mean and the variance of inference latency, triggering deadline misses in workflows where sensor data has to be processed within a hard per-unit deadline. To address this challenge, we propose UniPipe, a single-context system that unifies inference serving and fine-tuning of a DNN surrogate on a single edge GPU. UniPipe is driven by three key insights: both serving and fine-tuning require a forward pass and can be fused into one; the per-sample latency of modern GPUs is non-linear in batch size; and the workload is repetitive across intervals, enabling offline scheduling. Specifically, UniPipe fuses training and inference data in a single forward pass with a selective backward pass on the training subset, and uses a polynomial-time scheduler that exploits the latency curve to compute the batch composition. We evaluate UniPipe on a real-world Ptychographic reconstruction workflow with sensor rates up to 5000 patterns/sec.; UniPipe lowers reconstruction MSE by up to 30% and inference MSE by up to 50% over a pretrained baseline, and reduces the deadline-miss rate by 13%-22% over a multi-context baseline. UniPipe's unified deployment reduces the latency spread from 106% to 57% of the mean, and increases total throughput compared to multi-context baseline.

arXiv:2611.14748v1 公告类型：新
摘要：DNN 代理越来越多地用于加速必须近实时处理高速传感器流的科学工作流程，下一代 X 射线光源的叠层成像就是例证。此类代理的吞吐量比迭代求解器高 100-1000 倍，从而能够更快地引导实验。为了在实验期间保持代理的准确性，随着输入分布的变化，最先进的部署会冻结预训练的代理或运行单独的 CUDA 上下文，在服务的同时进行微调。然而，多上下文并发会导致 GPU 上发生严重争用，从而增加推理延迟的平均值和方差，从而引发工作流程中的截止日期错过，其中传感器数据必须在严格的每单位截止期限内进行处理。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 UniPipe，这是一种单上下文系统，可在单边缘 GPU 上统一 DNN 代理的推理服务和微调。 UniPipe 由三个关键见解驱动：服务和微调都需要前向传递，并且可以融合为一；现代 GPU 的每个样本延迟在批量大小上是非线性的；并且工作负载在不同时间间隔内重复，从而实现离线调度。具体来说，UniPipe 将训练和推理数据融合在一次前向传递中，并在训练子集上选择性地向后传递，并使用多项式时间调度程序来利用延迟曲线来计算批次组成。我们在真实世界的 Ptychography 重建工作流程中评估 UniPipe，传感器速率高达 5000 个图案/秒；与预训练基线相比，UniPipe 将重建 MSE 降低高达 30%，将推理 MSE 降低高达 50%，并将截止日期错过率比多上下文基线降低 13%-22%。与多上下文基线相比，UniPipe 的统一部署将延迟分布从平均值的 106% 减少到 57%，并提高了总吞吐量。

items.title: From Nodes to Pixels: Topological and Structural Two-View Graph Imaging
items.titleZh: 从节点到像素：拓扑和结构二视图成像
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14750v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Graph learning still lacks a broadly reusable input interface comparable to patches in vision or tokens in language. Unlike images or text, graphs are irregular, vary in size and density, and are invariant under many equivalent node labelings, making it difficult to standardize inputs across tasks and architectures. We introduce G2Image, a fixed-budget graph imaging framework that converts each graph into two complementary image-like views. TopoGrid provides a stable topological view by encoding an intrinsic bifiltration as a compact multipersistence surface grid, while GraphGrid provides a higher-bandwidth structural view by aggregating edge densities between groups defined by intrinsic node scores. Both views are permutation-invariant and come with resolution-controlled stability guarantees. Because the resulting representations are fixed-size tensors, they can be processed by lightweight 2D encoders and aligned through a supervised cross-view contrastive objective. Across graph classification and molecular prediction benchmarks, G2Image achieves strong average performance among the compared methods, improves over single-view and standard fusion variants, and extends to attribute-rich molecular graphs without changing the overall architecture. These results suggest that fixed-budget graph images offer a practical and reusable interface for graph representation learning.

arXiv:2611.14750v1 公告类型：新
摘要：图学习仍然缺乏可与视觉中的补丁或语言中的标记相媲美的广泛可重用的输入界面。与图像或文本不同，图形是不规则的，大小和密度各不相同，并且在许多等效节点标签下是不变的，这使得跨任务和架构的输入标准化变得困难。我们引入了 G2Image，一个固定预算的图形成像框架，它将每个图形转换为两个互补的类似图像的视图。 TopoGrid 通过将内在双过滤编码为紧凑的多持久性表面网格来提供稳定的拓扑视图，而 GraphGrid 通过聚合由内在节点分数定义的组之间的边缘密度来提供更高带宽的结构视图。两种视图都是排列不变的，并且具有分辨率控制的稳定性保证。由于生成的表示是固定大小的张量，因此它们可以由轻量级 2D 编码器处理，并通过监督的跨视图对比目标进行对齐。在图分类和分子预测基准中，G2Image 在比较方法中实现了强大的平均性能，改进了单视图和标准融合变体，并在不改变整体架构的情况下扩展到属性丰富的分子图。这些结果表明，固定预算图形图像为图形表示学习提供了实用且可重用的界面。

items.title: Graph Label Alignment: A Diagnostic Atlas for Graph Classification
items.titleZh: 图标签对齐：图分类的诊断图集
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14760v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Graph classification benchmarks vary widely in difficulty: some are solved by simple pooled baselines, while others remain challenging for GNNs and graph transformers. We take a data-centric view and ask whether benchmark success is driven by genuine structure--feature reasoning or by label signal already accessible from restricted marginal views. We introduce graph label alignment, a lightweight diagnostic that measures label accessibility through two supervised probes computed without training a graph encoder: structural label alignment (SLA), based on permutation-invariant topological and spectral summaries, and feature label alignment (FLA), based on pooled node features with edges removed. Across real graph classification benchmarks and multiple pooled backbones, the resulting SLA--FLA plane strongly organizes test accuracy, with low-alignment datasets forming a consistent regime where standard pooled pipelines struggle. To probe what lies beyond marginal accessibility, we introduce controlled interaction-dominated stress tests, including heterophilic ego-graphs and synthetic Twins tasks whose structural and feature marginals are matched across classes but whose role--feature couplings differ. These results show that high alignment explains much of easy benchmark performance, while low alignment reveals regimes where success requires preserving structure--feature correspondence beyond standard pooled representations.

arXiv:2611.14760v1 公告类型：新
摘要：图分类基准的难度差异很大：有些可以通过简单的池化基线来解决，而另一些对于 GNN 和图转换器来说仍然具有挑战性。我们采取以数据为中心的观点，并询问基准测试的成功是否是由真正的结构——特征推理驱动的，还是由从有限的边缘视图中已经可以访问的标签信号驱动的。我们引入了图标签对齐，这是一种轻量级诊断，通过在不训练图编码器的情况下计算的两个监督探针来测量标签可访问性：结构标签对齐（SLA），基于排列不变的拓扑和谱摘要，以及特征标签对齐（FLA），基于删除边缘的池化节点特征。在真实的图分类基准和多个池化主干中，生成的 SLA-FLA 平面强有力地组织了测试准确性，低对齐数据集形成了标准池化管道难以实现的一致机制。为了探究边际可达性之外的内容，我们引入了受控的交互主导的压力测试，包括异性自我图和合成双胞胎任务，其结构和特征边际在不同类别之间匹配，但其角色特征耦合不同。这些结果表明，高对齐解释了许多简单的基准性能，而低对齐揭示了成功需要保留超出标准池表示的结构特征对应的情况。

items.title: SPIRE: Task-agnostic embodied continual learning through autonomous situation inference and causal motor-primitive reuse
items.titleZh: SPIRE：与任务无关的体现通过自主情境推理和因果运动原语重用的持续学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14840v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Embodied continual learning requires controllers to infer changing situations, retain prior behavior and reuse motor skills without task labels or known boundaries. The challenge is deciding when to recover earlier behavior and which skills can support new learning. We introduce Situation-guided Primitive Integration for Recurrent Embodiment (SPIRE), a recurrent-spiking system that infers latent contexts from action-outcome evidence and learns context-specific motor actors online. Mature actors become protected sources that combine with a target-context residual to drive recurrent-spiking motor populations. Across coordinate, three-joint and hidden-force control, SPIRE maintained control, autonomously inferred situations, retained prior behavior and accelerated acquisition of an unseen source composition, reducing mean interactions to criterion by approximately 40% relative to matched fresh controllers. Rewinding compatible source actors impaired early acquisition in every matched intervention, demonstrating causal reuse. Against seven recurrent continual-learning and modular-control comparators, SPIRE achieved 2.4 times the mean prior-learning advantage of the strongest eligible task-free alternative selected for each paired stream. These results demonstrate autonomous recovery and causal reuse of motor skills for new learning in continuous embodied control.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14840v1 公告类型：新
摘要：具身持续学习要求控制器在没有任务标签或已知边界的情况下推断不断变化的情况，保留先前的行为并重用运动技能。挑战在于决定何时恢复早期行为以及哪些技能可以支持新的学习。我们引入了情境引导的循环实施原始整合（SPIRE），这是一种循环尖峰系统，可以从动作结果证据中推断出潜在的上下文，并在线学习上下文特定的运动参与者。成熟的参与者成为受保护的来源，与目标上下文残差相结合，驱动反复出现的运动群体。通过坐标、三关节和隐藏力控制，SPIRE 保持控制、自主推断情况、保留先前行为并加速获取未见过的源成分，相对于匹配的新控制器，将平均交互减少到标准约 40%。倒回兼容的源参与者会损害每个匹配干预中的早期获取，这证明了因果重用。与七个循环连续学习和模块化控制比较器相比，SPIRE 的平均先验学习优势是为每个配对流选择的最强合格无任务替代方案的 2.4 倍。这些结果证明了运动技能的自主恢复和因果重用可用于连续体现控制中的新学习。

items.title: Generalize Then Personalize: Wearable-Based Heart Rate Forecasting Under Scarce Ruck-March Data
items.titleZh: 概括然后个性化：稀缺 Ruck-March 数据下基于可穿戴设备的心率预测
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.14849v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Heart rate (HR) forecasting may provide advance information about near-future cardiovascular response, potentially supporting physiological monitoring and workload-management decisions during ruck marching. However, robust model development is constrained by the difficulty of collecting large-scale ruck-march datasets, creating a scarce-data problem in which models must generalize across participants while adapting to individuals from limited personal data. To address this problem, we benchmark population-only training (POT), personalized-from-scratch training (PFST), and population-pretrained fine-tuning (PPFT) for HR forecasting during loaded ruck marching using data from eight active-duty U.S. Army medics across thirteen sessions. LSTM, Attention-LSTM, and CNN-LSTM backbones were evaluated against a persistence baseline at 30 s and 60 s horizons. Across all neural architectures and horizons, PPFT yielded lower mean MAE, RMSE, and endpoint MAE than both POT and PFST. Participant-level paired analysis after averaging across three training seeds showed that, relative to PFST, PPFT reduced trajectory MAE by 2.22-4.30 bpm and endpoint MAE by 1.24-2.88 bpm. All six trajectory-MAE comparisons remained significant after Holm adjustment ($p_{adj}$ = 0.0469), while four of six endpoint-MAE comparisons remained significant after adjustment. At 30 s, persistence achieved the lowest MAE (3.555 $\pm$ 1.274 bpm), while CNN-LSTM PPFT achieved the lowest RMSE (4.669 $\pm$ 1.916 bpm); LSTM PPFT achieved the lowest endpoint MAE (5.093 $\pm$ 2.365 bpm). At 60 s, Attention-LSTM PPFT achieved the lowest MAE (5.573 $\pm$ 1.939 bpm) and RMSE (7.134 $\pm$ 2.260 bpm), while CNN-LSTM PPFT achieved the lowest endpoint MAE (7.553 $\pm$ 2.357 bpm). These results suggest that population pretraining followed by participant-specific fine-tuning may provide a practical strategy for scarce-data wearable HR forecasting.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.14849v1 公告类型：新
摘要：心率（HR）预测可以提供有关近期心血管反应的预先信息，有可能支持背包行进期间的生理监测和工作量管理决策。然而，强大的模型开发受到收集大规模 ruck-march 数据集的难度的限制，从而产生了稀缺数据问题，其中模型必须在参与者之间进行泛化，同时根据有限的个人数据适应个体。为了解决这个问题，我们使用八名现役美国陆军医务人员在十三次训练中的数据，对仅人群训练（POT）、从头开始的个性化训练（PFST）和人群预训练微调（PPFT）进行基准测试，以进行满载车辆行军期间的人力资源预测。 LSTM、Attention-LSTM 和 CNN-LSTM 主干网络根据 30 秒和 60 秒范围内的持久性基线进行评估。在所有神经架构和视野中，PPFT 产生的平均 MAE、RMSE 和端点 MAE 均低于 POT 和 PFST。对三个训练种子进行平均后的参与者级别配对分析表明，相对于 PFST，PPFT 将轨迹 MAE 降低了 2.22-4.30 bpm，将终点 MAE 降低了 1.24-2.88 bpm。所有六个轨迹 MAE 比较在 Holm 调整后仍然显着 ($p_{adj}$ = 0.0469)，而六个端点 MAE 比较中的四个在调整后仍然显着。在 30 秒时，持久性实现了最低的 MAE（3.555 $\pm$ 1.274 bpm），而 CNN-LSTM PPFT 实现了最低的 RMSE（4.669 $\pm$ 1.916 bpm）； LSTM PPFT 实现了最低端点 MAE（5.093 $\pm$ 2.365 bpm）。在 60 秒时，Attention-LSTM PPFT 实现了最低的 MAE（5.573 $\pm$ 1.939 bpm）和 RMSE（7.134 $\pm$ 2.260 bpm），而 CNN-LSTM PPFT 实现了最低的端点 MAE（7.553 $\pm$ 2.357 bpm）。这些结果表明，群体预训练以及针对特定参与者的微调可能为稀缺数据可穿戴式心率预测提供实用策略。
